title: MENA Statistical Method Change Registry
claim_boundary: This registry records documented statistical method and series breaks. It is not a ranking of statistical agencies and does not treat methodological change as evidence of poor quality.

records.effective_period: 2023 comprehensive revision; chain-linking introduced for real GDP in 2024
documented_changes: 2023 selected as the comprehensive revision year
expanded and updated data sources and coverage
chain-linking methodology introduced for real GDP in 2024
records.user_action: Preserve vintage identity. Do not assume pre- and post-revision releases are interchangeable for real-time analysis.

documented_changes: new comprehensive revision applied to quarterly GDP estimates from 2008 through Q2 2025
economic-sector detail expanded from 14 to 20 sectors
records.user_action: Record method version when using historical quarterly GDP. Avoid mixing archived pre-revision sector series with the revised series without an explicit bridge.

documented_changes: EMO2026 replaced the former ENE labour survey
employment is restricted to work for pay or profit
strict unemployment replaces the previous broader unemployment concept
labour underutilization is expanded into a multidimensional indicator system
annual household sample increased from 90,000 to 135,000
sampling frame updated using the 2024 population and housing census
new quarterly and annual household rotation design introduced
records.comparability_note: HCP states that EMO2026 results are not directly comparable with previously published ENE results. HCP is publishing provisional backcast indicators for 2017-2025 under the new concepts; comparison with those backcast indicators is methodologically valid.
records.user_action: For 2026 comparisons, use the EMO-compatible backcast series where available rather than splicing 2026 values directly onto the old ENE series.
